name: Necromancer: Frost Wyrm blasts enemies you fight every 2 seconds (#6667)
contract: Animate: Frost Wyrm 805428 reads 'flies behind the Necromancer that blasts nearby enemies every 2 sec ..., dealing ${$807339m1+(($spfr*0.702)+($INT*0.702))*0.212} Frost damage'.
